REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 28, 2016 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
APRIL 28, 2016, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Dr. William “Bill” C. Hundley II.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Members of the City of Cerritos Recreation
  Services Division Volunteer Program Andrew Morales, Angelo Urbiztondo, and
  Sydney Roybal.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Proclamations were presented as follows:

  Ophelia Lara (Gahr High School Girls Varsity Wrestler)

  Oriental Moo-Doo School (Business Spotlight Recognition)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Bob Quinlan requested sidewalk repair and expressed concerns about City
  government.

  Katherine Chu thanked the City Council for the Community Spring Festival on behalf
  of the participants of the Adaptive Recreation Program.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 28, 2016
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 28, 2016 in the total amount of
  $6,697,530.86 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated April 28, 2016 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency dated

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of April 14,
  2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of April 14, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration of consent to the assignment of a ground lease
  and approval of an estoppel certificate and ground lease amendment in connection
  with the assignment of the ground lease interests of Sheraton Hotel, located at
  12725 Center Court Drive, Cerritos, California, 90703, from Sunstone Center Court
  LLC, a Delaware Limited Liability Company, to Crown Jewel of Pacifica, LLC, a
  Delaware Limited Liability Company, or another affiliate of Dynasty Coachwork
  International Incorporated, a California Corporation approved by the City (7030-
  011-006) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Ryan E. McCarthy, Director of Acquisitions, Sunstone Hotel Investors, responded to
  inquiries from the City Council.

  Robb MacMillan, Vice President of Acquisitions, Continental Asset Management (Crown
  Jewel of Pacifica), responded to inquiries from the City Council.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments and the public hearing.
 City of Cerritos  April 28, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Authorize the City Manager/Executive Director, or his designee, to execute the
  document(s) to facilitate, acknowledge and consent to the transfer of the ground
  lease (APN 7030-011-006) from Sunstone Center Court LLC, A Delaware limited
  liability company, to Crown Jewel of Pacifica, LLC, a Delaware limited liability
  company, or another affiliate approved by the City, in such form as the City
  Manager shall deem appropriate, including any estoppel certificates, assignment
  consent, or related implementing documentation required or appropriate in
  connection with completion of such assignment; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager/Executive Director, or his designee, to execute the
  appropriate documents to facilitate finalization of the Property Improvement Plan
  and the Sixth Amendment to the Ground Lease after revising the Sixth
  Amendment to the Ground Lease in order to add a requirement that the new
  buyer, Crown Jewel of Pacifica, continuously maintain existing landscaping and
  trees on the subject property and that any extension of the Property Improvement
  Plan work, or additional work in accordance with the Sixth Amendment, beyond
  the approved thirty-six (36) month time frame, shall be subject to review and
  approval by the City Council (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2016-4, A PROPOSAL BY
  CERRITOS RETAIL CENTERCAL, LLC, TO DEMOLISH AN EXISTING SINGLE-TENANT
  RESTAURANT BUILDING AND REPLACE IT WITH A NEW TWO-TENANT RESTAURANT
  BUILDING IN THE EXISTING PLAZA 183 SHOPPING CENTER. THE SUBJECT
  PROPERTY IS ZONED REGIONAL COMMERCIAL (CR) AND IS LOCATED AT 11167
  183RD STREET (APN 7034-015-026) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Rupesh Bhakta, Vice President of Acquisitions and Development, representing
  Centercal, LLC, responded to inquiries from the City Council.

  Paul Bellanbaum suggested utilizing artificial palm trees for water conservation
  purposes.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to adopt Resolution

  PRECISE PLAN 2016-4, A PROPOSAL BY CERRITOS RETAIL CENTERCAL,
  LLC, TO DEMOLISH AN EXISTING SINGLE-TENANT RESTAURANT
  BUILDING AND REPLACE IT WITH A NEW TWO-TENANT RESTAURANT
  BUILDING IN THE EXISTING PLAZA 183 SHOPPING CENTER. THE
  SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED REGIONAL COMMERCIAL (CR) AND IS
  LOCATED AT 11167 183RD STREET (APN 7034-015-026) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8C.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS PERMIT
  2016-2, A PROPOSAL BY APPLICANT CROWN CASTLE NG WEST, LLC, ON BEHALF
  OF T-MOBILE/METROPCS TO INSTALL ONE (1) DISTRIBUTED ANTENNA SYSTEM
  CANISTER ANTENNA ON TOP OF AN EXISTING CITY-OWNED TRAFFIC SIGNAL
  LIGHT POLE AND RELATED UNDERGROUND SUPPORT EQUIPMENT IN THE PUBLIC
  RIGHT-OF-WAY AT 12569U SOUTH STREET, NEAR THE NORTHWEST CORNER OF
  BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AND SOUTH STREET (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Robert A. Lopez, Current Planning Manager. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to adopt Resolution

  WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS PERMIT 2016-2, A PROPOSAL BY
  APPLICANT CROWN CASTLE NG WEST, LLC, ON BEHALF OF T-

  SYSTEM CANISTER ANTENNA ON TOP OF AN EXISTING CITY-OWNED

  EQUIPMENT IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY AT 12569U SOUTH STREET,
  NEAR THE NORTHWEST CORNER OF BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AND SOUTH
  STREET (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  April 28, 2016

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of a site license agreement with Crown Castle NG West,
  LLC (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Lena Hoffmeyer, representing the applicant, responded to inquiries from the City
  Council.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to authorize the City
  Manager to approve and execute the Site License Agreement negotiated with Crown
  Castle NG West, LLC for the installation, operation and maintenance of a distributed
  antenna system canister antenna on the existing city-owned traffic signal light pole
  and related support equipment in the public right-of-way at 12569U South Street
  (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
